messages:
alex: Quick triage on Dedicated backlog — need to pick top 3 initiatives for the next sprint before Eng planning on Mon. Context: mix of customer-driven asks (VPC/KMS), infra work (autoscaler), and product polish (console cost/latency metrics). Proposing RICE + explicit sequencing by dependencies.

alex: Example RICE snapshot (rough estimates):
```
initiative | R | I | C | E | score
dedicated-autoscale | 6 | 8 | 3 | 5 | 48
console-cost-breakdown | 4 | 6 | 2 | 4 | 24
private-vpc-config | 5 | 7 | 5 | 6 | 35
```

alex: Main asks: 1) confirm we prefer RICE here, 2) surface major cross-team deps (eng-infra, security/legal), 3) realistic staffing constraints. Any objections or major missing items?

maria: +1 to RICE but suggest we upweight "customer"/SLA risk for deals in flight. Two enterprise prospects explicitly require VPC+KMS. That should bump private-vpc-config.

shaun: Heads-up: eng-infra capacity is tight. Autoscaler touches runtime kernel selection and autoscaling infra — estimate ~4 engineers x 3 sprints of focused work (including validation). If we move autoscale to top, other infra requests will slip.

ev an: (typo?) evan: Suggest sequencing to reduce blocking risk:
1) console-cost-breakdown — 2 weeks, low deps, high visibility for PLG and reduces ops load
2) dedicated-autoscale — 3-4 sprints, needs eng-runtime + eng-infra coordinated canary
3) private-vpc-config — high touch (security/legal), estimate 6-8 weeks end-to-end with reviews

ev an: For autoscale can we do a canary on a subset of dedicated pools to validate behavior before #2-wide rollout?

liz: I'd also prepare an impact vs effort 2x2 for the exec slides. RICE is great for engineering prioritization but execs want customer $$ and SLA risk visuals. I can sketch slides if someone shares final R/I/C/E numbers.

pm-bot: Reminder: Eng planning meeting Mon 09:00. Agenda suggestion: finalize top 3 initiatives, assign owners, list blockers and cross-team contacts.

alex: Plan: I'll draft a short prioritization doc with the RICE scores + dependency map and owners, share by EOD today. If you have different estimates or hard constraints, DM me before 5pm.

maria: Adding customer refs: CUST-482 (VPC request), CUST-499 (KMS + audit logs). These are deal-impacting.

shaun: I'll ping eng-infra for capacity check and post an update here by 16:00.

ev an: I'll draft a canary plan and a minimal test matrix (latency, cold-start, eviction behavior) and attach to your doc, alex.

liz: :thumbsup: thanks — will prep the 2x2 and executive note once you post numbers.

alex: Thanks everyone. If nothing major changes I'll post the doc at 17:30 and queue it for review.
